summary: Increment-and-read loop: repeatedly increments the caller-owned counter at offset 0 of a1, reads the next value via BufferedByteReader(a2), and continues while the predicate sub_589BF3(v2) is true. Returns the last value read. Structure is a documented twin of MultiFieldPointerFree (00414380). Called by sub_58E4D2.

operations.description: do-while loop that increments the counter at offset 0 of a1 and reads through the buffer until the predicate sub_589BF3 returns false.
++*a1: increment the caller-owned counter stored at offset 0 of the a1 pointer.
v2 = BufferedByteReader(a2): read the next value from the buffered byte reader each iteration.
Loop continuation guard: while sub_589BF3(v2) is non-zero, keep incrementing and reading.
Return v2, the last value produced by BufferedByteReader.
Invoked by sub_58E4D2 as part of its byte-reading path.

unresolved: Purpose of the sub_589BF3 predicate and the meaning of its return value is not established here.
Semantics of the caller-owned counter at offset 0 of a1 and the data read by BufferedByteReader are caller-defined.
